audit.why: Poke-burst lane where Vlad survives early, gets re-pressured at 6/1st item, and out-scales at two items — matches both kits and the 56% WR at 1641 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart reads Brand x4 then Skill x3; content and packet both read Brand,Brand,Brand,Vladimir,Brand,Brand,Vladimir. Two layers disagree on rows 3-6.
audit.why: Content whys are kit-coherent: Q sustain contests at 4-5, Pyroclasm+Sear burst wins 6, Liandry's spike wins 1st item, Vlad wins 2+ items. Aligning full to that.
audit.corrected: phases[3].side->Vladimir, phases[4].side->Brand (why rewritten), phases[5].side->Brand (why rewritten), phases[6].side->Vladimir.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no numbers; two Do's/Don'ts bodies are pasted tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.why: Brand Q is 8s rank 1 (6 max), W 10s, E 13s, R 100s; Vlad pool 28s early — the stun-only-when-ablaze mechanic plus these numbers is the matchup's core.

audit.whatIsWrong: suspectNames flags 'Sanguine Pool' but that is Vladimir's real W name — false positive.

edits.before: Hemoplague online — the all-in inverts: Q-E-R-E with ignite kills most mids who thought they were winning.
edits.after: Hemoplague is online, but his Pyroclasm plus a Sear stun is the faster burst — his level-6 all-in beats yours.

edits.before: Riftmaker timing: every trade heals more than it costs. Extended fights are now donations to your health bar.
edits.after: His Liandry's spike lands first — the Blaze DoT and W poke chew through your heal until your own item catches up.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Sanguine Pool for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Brand Sear: 8s at rank 1, 6 at max — it only stuns while you are ablaze, so after eating W or E its downtime is your step-up window. - Pyroclasm is 100s: once the bounces are spent he has no kill threat for ages. - Pool is 28s early — emergencies only.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E-charge as he steps to answer, release and walk — the trade costs him HP and pays yours.
edits.after: His W is 10s and E 13s at rank 1 — after his combo lands or whiffs, that gap is your Q-E window before he re-stacks Blaze.

edits.before: Pooling his poke and then eating the real engage at half HP with nothing — the pool is a combo-breaker, not a flinch reflex.
edits.after: At half HP with pool down you are one Sear stun from a full-combo death — back off until the 28-second cooldown returns your 'no'.

notes: Packet defect claims the chart contradicts the 56% WR (Brand 5/7 stages) — but Vlad's WR comes from out-scaling and teamfights, not stage wins; the Brand-heavy early/mid chart is kit-coherent, so I aligned the full layer to the content/packet chart rather than flipping stages toward Vladimir. suspectNames 'Sanguine Pool' is a false positive (real W name).
